title: Turbine City
brief: Original-IP sports-arcade game (sub-genre: sports-arcade). Capture the core mechanics and game-feel of "Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 2" (critically acclaimed, 98%) — but with your OWN original name, theme, characters and art. Do NOT reference or reuse that title's IP. SIGNATURE MECHANIC for this genre: . design_doc.title: Turbine City
design_doc.core_loop: Players pilot hovercrafts through sprawling urban environments, chaining together aerial tricks, wall-rides, and grind sequences on rails and edges to build massive combo multipliers before landing. Each run is a 2-minute session where you hunt for high-value trick lines, discover hidden zones, and complete skill challenges while maintaining flow. The tension between pushing for one-more-trick versus landing safely creates the signature risk-reward rhythm. Combos decay on landing or bail, rewarding creativity and spatial awareness.
verbs: revert (land into manual to extend combo)
design_doc.scope: IN: 3 distinct city zones (downtown, industrial, rooftop), 10 unique trick types with combo chaining, 2-minute timed runs, score-based progression (bronze/silver/gold thresholds), 5 skill challenges per zone (high score, combo length, collectibles, specific trick goals, hidden area unlock), arcade physics (exaggerated air-time, generous grind magnetism), persistent high-score table, difficulty modes (Casual/Pro affect timer + score thresholds). OUT: multiplayer, character customization, vehicle upgrades, open-world persistence, story/narrative elements, more than 3 zones, licensed music (use royalty-free or original loops), complex progression trees.
design_doc.art_direction: Neo-Tokyo meets industrial brutalism. Palette: neon cyan/magenta accents on concrete gray and matte black surfaces, high-contrast lighting, cel-shaded hovercraft with glowing thruster trails. Mood: kinetic, optimistic, arcade-vibrant. UI uses chunky geometric fonts, combo counters explode with particle bursts, trick names flash in bold uppercase. Zones feel lived-in but stylizedâ€”graffiti tags, holographic billboards, steam vents, modular architecture that telegraphs grindable edges and launchable ramps.

milestone_plan.M1: Vertical slice: Single test arena (50m x 50m box with rails, ramps, walls). Hovercraft movement (boost, jump, basic air control), grind on one rail type, wallride on vertical surface, combo counter increments and resets on landing/bail. Win state = hit 10,000 points in 2 minutes. Placeholder UI shows score, timer, combo multiplier.
milestone_plan.M2: Core mechanics locked: All 10 trick types implemented and chainable (grinds, manuals, reverts, flips, spins, stalls). Physics tuning passâ€”air-time, grind magnetism, manual balance window. Combo decay timing finalized. Bail state triggers on failed landing or balance loss. HUD shows trick names, combo string, multiplier. FFG.Shell menu integration (title screen, difficulty select, how-to screen with verb list, settings for audio/fullscreen).
milestone_plan.M3: Content complete: 3 full zones designed and playable, each with 5 skill challenges. Collectibles (floating tokens) placed in hard-to-reach lines. Difficulty modes functional (Casual = 3min timer, easier thresholds; Pro = 2min, strict scoring). High-score persistence works. Audio: 3 looping background tracks (one per zone), SFX for grinds/landings/boosts/bails. Art passâ€”zones visually distinct, grindable surfaces clearly marked (edge highlights, material cues).
milestone_plan.M4: Polish and juice: Particle effects for tricks, screen-shake on big landings, combo counter UI animations (scale pulse, color shift at 2x/5x/10x multipliers), trick-name flash positioning refined. Camera smoothing and FOV tweaks for speed sensation. Pause menu with restart/quit options. Audio mix balanced. Performance passâ€”stable 60fps, no hitches during combo chains. Playtesting feedback incorporated (grind magnetism tuning, jump arc adjustments).
milestone_plan.M5: Ship-ready: All FFG.Shell requirements met (working menu flow, page controls, fullscreen/mute/pause functional). Win state = complete all bronze challenges in one zone OR hit global score threshold. Lose state = timer expires with no medal earned. Tutorial/how-to screen lists all verbs with example GIF or static illustration. Definition-of-done checklist verified. Build tested in target deployment environment (WebGL or standalone), no console errors, clean exit to menu after win/lose.
